notes:
- Fixed video generation ending with "ComfyUI finished without saving a video".
  The clip was being rendered and saved, but the studio looked for it in the
  wrong place in ComfyUI's report. Videos now complete and appear in the Video
  tab. A video that already failed this way has to be generated again.
- Added an **Open folder** button beside the Video preview and beside Queue &
  recent images. It opens the folder where finished videos and images are saved.
- The folder finished work is saved in is now `data/media` instead of
  `data/images`, since it holds videos too. Existing images move across by
  themselves the first time this build starts.
